project.summary: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.

release.changelog: Declares the DSH Hub Workshop intake manifest (package.json#dshWorkshop, omdsh-workshop-package/v1): harness-profile integration, transactional install, restart-profile activation, structured permissions, and a named /rules command capability.

management.label: dsh plugin add
management.instructions: Install with: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "github:PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules#b0132581bb59ebdd833798f2b457b66a171fff70", then restart the profile. Rule files are read per session workspace (default <cwd>/.dsh/rules.yaml).

declarations.permissions: Reads rule files under the session workspace and the configured fallback path; watches those paths (and expected-but-absent candidates) for hot reload; appends log-only permissionRules/decision audit events to the session log. No network access, no subprocesses, no sandbox changes.
declarations.testing: 139 vitest tests across 9 suites using the real rc.6 Context/Session/Commands/ApprovalService, plus GitHub Actions CI (3 OS x Node 22/24) and a local dsh --dump-config mount verification on Windows. Harness-produced v2 lifecycle evidence is not yet produced (the current isolated executor requires macOS sandbox-exec); evidence paths in package.json#dshWorkshop remain null.

capability.expected: lists the active permission rules with their source files
